source.name: CatScreen official public sample snapshot
source.license_note: Public sample obtained from the official dataset page; full release is governed by the CatScreen institutional research license.

target: Three CatScreen diagnostic screening labels: normal, cataract, or other ocular condition.
architecture: Probability blend: existing MobileNetV3-Small context CNN (75%) + pretrained ResNet-18 context CNN (25%).
context: Laterality plus acquisition/quality context (reflection, image quality, illumination type). The public snapshot does not include the full patient clinical metadata, so this is not a complete clinical-fusion validation.
split_strategy: Official train/validation/test files; verified zero participant-ID overlap.
limitations: The held-out test contains only 40 images from 37 participants; uncertainty is large.
The public snapshot does not include the full patient metadata described for the licensed release, so the structured branch uses laterality and acquisition context only.
Image quality and acquisition settings may encode site/device shortcuts and require external validation.
No calibration, subgroup safety study, prospective evaluation, or clinical validation was performed.
Predictions must not assign diagnosis, treatment, referral urgency, or workflow priority.
Normal-class recall remains only 25% on eight normal test images.
The original training metric used random augmentation; the new training score uses deterministic evaluation, so those training scores are not directly comparable.
A 99% training-accuracy candidate was rejected due to validation overfitting.
test_reuse_note: Historical test sets reused once after selections were sealed, not a new external validation. No test predictions were used to select candidates or epochs.
tuning_summary: Training/validation-selected model blend. Historical test used once for final non-regression check; no further tuning after test results.
uncertainty_note: Small measured improvement; intervals are wide and no statistical superiority or clinical validation is established.
